killedBy: tank geometry draws the shipped hull when the role lever is unpulled, vertex for vertex
why: Drops the hull lever on the floor: `tankParts` would accept `hullCorner` and `hullNose` and draw the shipped hull regardless, so issue #831's arm would render as the shipped tank and be ranked against the other six levers as though it read poorly. A lever that silently does nothing is the worst outcome for a comparison whose whole purpose is to rank levers against each other -- it would be recorded as measured and rejected. Killed by the control half of the identity test, which pulls the lever and requires the vertex buffer to move.
